title: Split PipelineContext policy and port modules
description: Move pipeline context policy configs, injected ports, in-memory state, content safety strategy, provider preference storage, quote policy, and result decoration config into focused modules.

files.change: Own PipelineContext and re-export context submodules.
Move wake, whitelist, rate limit, provider fallback, and result decorate configs.
Move SessionStatusPort, ProviderPreferencePort, QuoteContextPolicy, and ContentSafetyStrategy traits.

criteria: context.rs or context/mod.rs is focused on PipelineContext composition.
Policy stage imports remain stable through re-exports.

implementation_steps: Extract config structs and keep re-exports.
Extract trait ports and in-memory implementations.
Move focused tests with the modules they verify.
